PLAHIS Planning Application Reference: DM2025/01053--- Address: 38 Crichton RoadCarshaltonSM5 3LS--- Proposal: Application to vary conditions 1 (approved drawings) and 4 (first floor flank window(s) to be obscure glass and fixed shut to a height of 1.7m) of planning permission Ref: DM2019/00481 for the 'Erection of a two storey side infill extension. Erection of a two storey front infill extension. Erection of a part one, part two storey rear extension and the formation of steps leading up to the new front door' to allow the erection of a single storey front/side extension to integrate the flank garage into the dwelling, formation of a front entrance porch with steps up to the front entrance door, alterations to main roof and ground floor rear roof presentation/details including the lowering of the main roof ridge line, removal of a flank chimney breast and stack, relocation of the central chimney and replacement of the roof lantern with a smaller roof light, alterations to all fenestrations including the provision of a roof to the ground floor front bay window, white render external finish and changes to the internal floor space layouts.--- Status: INV--- Decision: --- Date Decision Issued: ---
